scope: Executed functional sub-tasks on synthetic controlled files, using session subagents; not Claude-native routing or full six-image generator evaluation
iteration1: three paired with-v0 versus no-skill executions, fresh context, identical task inputs
iteration2: if execution failures justify a general skill improvement: revised skill versus frozen-v0, same tasks, independent fresh executions
grading: frozen assertions, independent artifact/CLI/browser verification, no self-grading
timing: actual token/duration notification metadata absent: total_tokens null; observed wallclock recorded separately, no invented model throughput
review: official upstream generate_review.py through separate static adapter, qualitative outputs plus benchmark; download feedback.json on public static site
limits: single execution per configuration/case; not stochastic reliability
synthetic fixture success does not establish human anatomy, imagegen quality or physical garment fit
